rationale: M49 zig review (Z1-Z3, 2026-09-12). Z3: bare value reads (`return Limit`) — the analyzer AND the oracle were blind to them; a read resolves only to file-scope Constant/Variable/Function/EnumMember names, is suppressed by walk-order shadowing (param `counter`, block local `Limit`, payload capture `Answer`), never fires on declaration positions, callees, member leaves or labels, and enum members resolve ONLY as value-position error leaves (`return error.Timeout`, `error.Fatal` in a switch arm) — bare enum-member names are invalid Zig, so the `Widget` return type (colliding with an enum member of `Names`) and the global `|fast|` payload must NOT emit. Forbids also pin the error-set DECLARATION-site class (`error{ Timeout, Fatal, Unused }` declares Unused; it must never read it). Z1: real per-symbol cyclomatic complexity (score=5, guard=4). Z2: 1-based error columns (the trailing stray brace is line 103, column 1). Z11 RE-PIN (2026-09-28): the `takeT -> T` row was authored under the pre-fix kind dispatch, where a `builtin_type` alias was published as a `constant`; it is re-pinned to the declared-type edge, which is the same fact under the label that names it, plus a forbid on the value read that the old kind made possible.

expectComplexity.comment: Z1: 1 + if + for + while + switch (binary </> and += are NOT conditions)

expectRelationships.comment: error leaf in a value position (return)
error leaf in a switch arm (value position)
Z6: the post-switch read is genuine — the arm capture must not leak past its arm
Z6: the arm body reads the file const
Z7: a name appearing only in a parameter's type does not shadow the file value

Z11/Z7 (re-pinned 2026-09-28): `const T = u32;` is a TYPE ALIAS, and `fn takeT(x: T)` reads it in a TYPE position. The fact is still in the graph, under the declared-type label that names what kind of dependency it is. It is no longer a bare VALUE read, because types do not resolve as values — the same rule Z4 established for enum members at type positions ('a bare enum-member name is invalid Zig'), applied to the type side.
Z7: a default value reads the file const

forbidRelationships.comment: block local shadows the file-scope const
payload capture shadows the file-scope const
error-set declaration site declares, never reads (WriteFailed class)
enum member Widget must not resolve as a bare value at the struct type positions (return type)
bare enum members are invalid Zig outside error leaves; the global payload binding must not emit a BARE identifier_usage (the qualified Mode.fast member-read is a different, legitimate surface)
Z6: a global switch-arm capture reads nothing — the capture binds in its own arm frame

Z11: a type alias read in a parameter's TYPE position is not a value read. Pre-fix `const T = u32;` was published as a `constant` (builtin_type sat in the value list) and this read was emitted as one; with T a type it is the declared-type edge above and nothing else.
